rec.name: Collection Quick Add to Cart with Size Picker (Fashion)
rec.status: Built — launched (tested internally, documented, source code handed over; theme-editor configurability planned for v1.1)

what.text: A quick add-to-cart feature for collection product cards. Each card shows a small cart/bag icon over the product image. Clicking it opens a size-picker overlay on the image, showing the variant options (e.g. XS, S, M, L) as white tiles with a close (X) button. Clicking a size adds that variant to the cart immediately (quantity 1) and opens the mini cart. Single-variant products add directly on the first click. Sold-out variants are marked as sold out and, when clicked, trigger the back-in-stock (BIS) flow instead of adding to cart, as on the PDP.

why.text: It removes the click-through to the PDP for shoppers who already know what they want (e.g. returning fashion customers who know their size), so the path from browsing to cart is shorter. Choosing a size is the only decision required, so friction is minimal. Sold-out sizes shown up front set expectations and capture demand via BIS. The mini cart opening gives instant confirmation and encourages further browsing and a higher items-per-order count.

how.text: 1) Add a checkbox setting 'Enable quick add to cart (custom)' (id product_add_to_cart_custom) to settings_schema.json. The theme's existing 'Enable quick add to cart' toggle is separate and activates the theme's default quick add. 2) Add the JS to custom.js: a delegated click handler on .product-item-atc (opens the picker if it has the open_sizes class, otherwise adds the first variant directly); a swatch click handler that finds the matching variant from the data-variants JSON, updates sold-out states, then POSTs to /cart/add.js with quantity 1 and dispatches the theme's cart:updated and cart:refresh events (openMiniCart: true); sold-out swatches trigger .BIS_trigger; a close handler removes the .active class from .card-size-picker. 3) In product-item.liquid, inside product-item__image-wrapper, render the 'card-size-picker' snippet when the setting is on. 4) Create the snippets card-size-picker, variant-picker-custom (builds swatch containers per option from product.options_with_values and outputs product.variants as JSON in data-variants), icon-product-block-cart, icon-size-picker-close and icon-mail. 5) Style the overlay (a bar at the bottom of the card image with white size tiles and an X on the right). Built on the Focal-based theme; porting to other themes requires adjustments.

items: Enable quick add to cart (custom): on/off checkbox, default on (theme setting)
Enable quick add to cart: the theme's native quick add toggle, kept separate
Design variations selectable in the section (per the Pegador reference); not yet configurable in v1, planned for v1.1
Size tile size and styling: CSS only for now, planned to become configurable in v1.1

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with a product-item.liquid card and a custom.js file. The code uses the Focal theme's cart events (cart:updated, cart:refresh) and window.themeVariables.routes. Needs a back-in-stock app that provides a .BIS_trigger element. Pegador used a BIS app that is not installed in the demo store, so sold-out behavior there is only approximated. No metafields required. A Non-Dev installation is not possible (the ticket says so). The source code is delivered as a TXT file and documented in Slite.
